name: Bug Diagnosis
description: Reproduce or inspect a failure, name an evidence-backed cause, then repair it and rerun the failing check.

permissionsRequired.reason: Locate the code implicated by the failure.
Read the implicated source before naming a cause.
Collect compiler diagnostics for the failure.
Reproduce the failure and rerun the same check after a repair.
Repair the diagnosed cause, and nothing else.
Recheck types when the failure is a type error.

validation.rule: The stated cause cites a file, diagnostic, or failing check read before any edit, and that check was rerun.
